releaseNotes:
⬇️ The Download button in update prompts now opens the browser
✨ Fresh new design across every screen
🏷️ Statuses are consistent everywhere (New, In Talks, Approved, Completed, Not Interested, Closed Lost, Cancelled)
📅 'This week' counter, calendar conflicts and analytics date ranges fixed
⚡ Long-press an enquiry for Add note, Share, Mark not interested and Request review
features: NEW: Redesigned app - glass navigation, cleaner dashboard, enquiry list, calendar, analytics and settings
NEW: Long-press actions on dashboard rows - Add note, Share, Mark not interested, Request review
NEW: Revenue KPI caption explains it is the booked value of enquiries created in the period
IMPROVED: Status names always use the official labels, even for older enquiries
IMPROVED: In Talks tab shows every in-talks enquiry; past ones are closed automatically each night
IMPROVED: Calendar only flags a conflict when two or more approved bookings share a day
IMPROVED: Kanban column titles follow admin label settings
IMPROVED: Enquiries list loads straight away on cold start
bugFixes: Fixed update prompt Download button doing nothing on Android 11+
Fixed 'This week' counter missing today's events and counting lost enquiries
Fixed analytics custom date range dropping the last day
Fixed old status values (e.g. Quote Sent, Confirmed) showing wrong labels or missing from filters
Fixed status-change push notifications not being sent to assignees
Fixed automatic closing of past enquiries using the wrong timezone; changes now appear in History
